name: codex-app-server
responsibility: One private Codex app-server session over stdio
description: TASK-653.11: 16 functions, and no class, across eight entries. ./connection: openCodexConnection, openCodexSession. ./failure: readCodexFailure, createCodexFailure. ./process: createCodexProcess (it absorbs createProcessOwner, whose options let tests replace the spawn, the file system and the clock), resolveCodexExecutable. ./session: isQueuedSubmission, parseCodexServerResponse, parseSupportedLoginAccountParams, codexSessionThreadSource. ./contract: codexPendingReverseRequestLimit, codexFieldSchema (thread status callers parse its threadStatusType field in place of isCodexThreadStatusType), createCodexCommandExecutionApprovalDecisionSchema. ./identity: logicalToolCallKey, canonicalItemIdMaxLength. ./protocol: codexProtocolVersion. ./transport hands out types only. The seven error classes, createCodexTransport, createCodexSession, codexSessionControl and the identity ledger and authority factories are private: callers open a connection and read a failure. The process stays apart from the connection, because one process yields many children and a connection belongs to one child and epoch (ADR 0089).
